cohort: 500 consecutive cesarean sections performed at a tertiary referral center in Bengaluru, India over 29 months (January 2011 to June 2013).
finding: While maternal morbidity was similar between emergency and elective cesarean section patients, fetal outcomes were worse in the emergency cesarean section group.
birth_weight: Neonates in the emergency CS group tended to have significantly lower birth weight.
